body.name: Matched-date-block effective replication
body.construction: For \(t\le T-m\), let \(\Sigma_{tt}^{\mathrm{diag}}\) be the \(G_t\times G_t\) block, \(v_t^{\mathrm{diag}}=\{\mathbf 1^{\prime}(\Sigma_{tt}^{\mathrm{diag}})^{-1}\mathbf 1\}^{-1}\), and \(\widetilde Z_t=v_t^{\mathrm{diag}}\mathbf 1^{\prime}(\Sigma_{tt}^{\mathrm{diag}})^{-1}Z_t^{\mathrm{diag}}\). Under \(q_g=1/T\), writing \(r=T-t\), this gives \(v_{T-r}^{\mathrm{diag}}=2\sigma^2T^2/\{Nr(T-r)\}\).
